Miraidon

Electric Dragon

Paldea · Generation 9 · Legendary Pokémon

Miraidon is an Electric/Dragon-type Paradox Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 3.5 m tall and weighs 240 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (135), with a base stat total of 670.
